title: VPN will not connect
steps: Check that you are on a working internet connection without the VPN.
Quit the VPN client fully and start it again.
Sign in again so the client gets a fresh certificate.
If it still fails, note the error code and raise a network ticket.

title: Password reset or account locked
steps: Use the self-service password portal to reset your password.
Wait 15 minutes if the account is locked after failed attempts, then try again.
If self-service is not enrolled, the service desk can verify your identity and unlock the account.

title: Multi-factor authentication prompt not arriving
steps: Open the authenticator app and check that the phone time is set automatically.
Use a one-time code from the app instead of the push notification.
If you changed phones, ask the service desk to re-register your MFA device.

title: Outlook not syncing or not sending mail
steps: Check the connection status at the bottom of Outlook.
Restart Outlook and look in the Outbox for stuck messages.
If the mailbox is full, archive or delete large items.
Rebuild the Outlook profile if the problem continues.

title: Laptop running out of disk space
steps: Empty the recycle bin and clear the downloads folder.
Run Disk Cleanup and remove temporary files.
Move large personal files to approved cloud storage.

title: Laptop slow or freezing
steps: Restart the laptop if it has been on for several days.
Close browser tabs and apps you are not using.
Install pending system updates.
If it still freezes, raise a hardware ticket with the asset tag.

title: Printer not printing
steps: Check the printer is on, has paper and shows no error light.
Remove and re-add the network printer from the print portal.
Clear stuck jobs from the print queue.

title: Request access to an SAP role or business application
steps: Raise an access request in the self-service portal and name the exact role.
Your manager must approve the request.
Access is usually provisioned within one business day after approval.

title: Install approved software
steps: Open the company software centre and search for the application.
Install it from there; no admin rights are needed for approved software.
For software not in the catalogue, raise a software request with a business reason.

title: Teams calls or meetings not working
steps: Check the right microphone and camera are selected in Teams device settings.
Sign out of Teams and sign back in.
Clear the Teams cache and restart the app.

title: Application cannot connect to the database
steps: Check whether the database service shows an outage on the status page.
Confirm the connection string and that the service account password has not expired.
Collect the error message and time, then raise an application support ticket.

title: CI build or deployment pipeline failing
steps: Open the failed pipeline run and read the first error in the log.
Re-run the job once to rule out a temporary agent problem.
If a dependency download fails, check the artifact repository status.
Raise an application ticket with the pipeline link if it keeps failing.
